channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: This period brought no major new FDI, expansion, or federal-award wins; coverage instead centered on structural risk signals for site selectors. A Birling Capital analysis pegs daily small-business losses from grid and water unreliability near $35M, while separate reporting confirms chronic water-system losses (60% of treated water lost) are now forcing active rationing. A $5.887B, 10-year AEE contract with Power Expectations for 400MW of temporary generation drew scrutiny after El Nuevo Día couldn't verify the company's leadership or local offices, a governance flag worth tracking. A UPR/GEM survey also found early-stage entrepreneurship activity fell sharply to 15.6% (from 24.3% in 2024) as post-pandemic federal funding dried up.
